'''Nayel''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Supreme Commander]] of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] [[King/Legends|King's]] [[Bouris Ulgo]] forces during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. In [[3643 BBY]], he was stationed at the [[Castle Panteer]]&mdash;taken over by [[House Ulgo]]&mdash;where he was [[Death/Legends|killed]] during an assault on the King Ulgo that resulted in his removal from throne.
